actions.reason: health and checkout fail with 'no such table: products'; idempotent migration creates missing tables without deleting rows.

root_causes.evidence: /health 503 'no such table: products'; /products and POST /orders 500 with the same OperationalError; the 1.5s latency was the uncached upstream fetch failing on every request.

report.summary: The products table was missing from the database. I ran the idempotent migration, which was approved by a human. All 5 smoke tests now pass: health, catalog (8 products), latency (3 ms), stats_integrity (40 orders, 7887.5 revenue, unchanged) and checkout (order persisted). I changed no config or code, and the other services were fine.
